translations.web: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
translations.bsb: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
translations.kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
translations.asv: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish. Psalm 133 A Song of Ascents; of David.
